name: Waiting on you
summary: Which threads did I leave hanging?
description: Flags threads whose last message is inbound and older than the waiting threshold, so the card shows the follow-ups you owe rather than the mail you already handled. Thread state and ages come from the metadata bridge, never from message bodies. Reads message metadata only: counts, senders, ages and thread state. It never opens a message body, never reads attachments, and never sends mail.
highlights: Threads whose last message is inbound and unanswered
Each thread with the age of that last inbound message
A 24-hour message delta so the thread count has context
